articles.title: Russian lab worker reportedly dies of plague: What happened at the anti-plague institute, how pneumonic plague spreads and why authorities acted quickly
articles.description: A laboratory worker’s death in Siberia has triggered concern over a possible plague exposure, but Russian health authorities have not publicly confirmed that plague caused her death. The 28-year-old employee of the Anti-Plague Research Institute in Shelekhov, near Irkutsk, was diagnosed with pneumonia of “unknown aetiology” before she died on October 2.Reports have linked the case to an alleged laboratory accident involving Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes plague. That detail remains unverified, making it important to separate what is reported from what has actually been confirmed.(AI generated representative image)
